reference.finding: NSGA-II-PO includes CAPO initialization, crossover, mutation and full-development evaluation; it does not use progressive intensification or mixed-fidelity selection.
reference.scope: NSGA-III, SPEA2 and Random Search here are additional prompt-search adaptations, not baselines defined or evaluated in the MO-CAPO paper.

baseline_protocol.shared_initialization: Same frozen instruction pool, random 0..kmax demonstrations and demonstration verification convention as Tri-Fair; label-only demonstrations remain a shared configured difference from the paper's reasoning-shot setup.
baseline_protocol.variation: Original CAPO crossover/mutation for NSGA-II, NSGA-III and SPEA2; frozen-pool independent proposals for Random Search.
baseline_protocol.removed: Custom objective-aware variation for the three evolutionary comparators
baseline_protocol.retained: Required initialization, standard proposal operators, original method-specific parent/survival selectors, identical three-objective metrics, strict token accounting, caching and admission retries
baseline_protocol.historical_results: Original method identities and implementations remain unchanged. The new Plain suffix prevents silently mixing protocols.
baseline_protocol.expected_direction_of_performance_change: Unknown; plain operators can perform better or worse. No deliberately weakened selection, metric, population, budget or decoding rule is used.

tri_fair_protocol.new_component: Fairness-readiness warm-up: after the initial common random block, add search blocks to the initial population until all pass the unchanged fairness gate.
tri_fair_protocol.block_choice: Existing metadata-and-observed-uncertainty selector. No model predictions or validation/test outcomes from unseen blocks are consulted.
tri_fair_protocol.warmup_budget: Every downstream token counts against the same search and total caps; diagnostics separate the additional initialization cost.
tri_fair_protocol.remaining_algorithm: Original CAPO variation, progressive shared-block racing, partial rejected challengers, weaker-dominance selection and gap-first incumbent advancement remain inherited from v9.2.
tri_fair_protocol.limitation: If supported fairness requires all search blocks, warm-up can collapse the initial fidelity advantage and make racing little different from full evaluation. This is reported rather than hidden.
tri_fair_protocol.not_an_exact_reproduction: The readiness-aware initialization schedule is an explicit fairness adaptation. Use unchanged v9.2 as the structural-reproduction control.
tri_fair_protocol.failure_behavior: Fail with diagnostics when full search coverage cannot satisfy existing fairness gates. No threshold relaxation or synthetic objective substitution.

metrics_and_protocol.reserve_policy: Same frozen terminal audit reserve for all methods. Unused reserve is reported; an equal ceiling is not equal actual expenditure.
metrics_and_protocol.pilot: Single seed72, four datasets; default ablation8 runs, explicit screen20 runs; no automatic full matrix or5M submission
metrics_and_protocol.GPU: H200, batch-invariant inference and structured labels consistently across methods

validation_limits: CPU behavioral and integration tests only. GPU quality improvement and statistical superiority remain untested.
